sources.title: CDN Cost Estimator — Monthly Bandwidth & Delivery Cost
sources.snippet: Set the average object size — the mean size of each response in KB. Set the cache-hit ratio as a percentage — the fraction of requests served from the CDN edge without hitting your origin. The tool computes total bandwidth served (requests × object size) and origin pull bandwidth (cache misses × object size).

sources.title: CDN Bandwidth Calculator for Edge Offload
sources.snippet: Adjusts peak concentration without changing monthly transfer. Requests per month Total CDN object requests, including images, scripts, files, and cacheable responses. Average object size Use a weighted average across the cacheable objects in this traffic group. Object size unit Large download presets use MB; API and image traffic often uses KB.

sources.snippet: As part of my job at DoiT International (AWS Premier Partner), I help customers to optimize their content delivery network (CDN) usage and monitoring. And sometimes AWS will ask the customer to meet a certain level of Average Object Size (AOS).
